headline: Bid openings for City Hall administrative office relocation, plus Oak Hill tennis courts and playground construction award.
summary: The meeting covers bids for the City Hall administrative office relocation. It also covers the award of the Oak Hill tennis courts and playground contract. Other items include contract amendments, a police recording system relocation quote, and Muni Link billing.
